input:
In /home/eval/pkgs there are dependency lists deps.txt, deps-big.txt and deps-cycle.txt. Each non-comment line has the form `package: dep1 dep2 ...` (deps are separated by spaces or tabs; there may be extra whitespace around names and the colon). `#` starts a comment that runs to the end of the line, blank lines are ignored, a package may appear on several lines (its deps accumulate), and a name that only ever appears as a dependency is still a package.

Write an executable script /home/eval/pkgs/bin/order (bash; awk/sort/etc. are fine, no python) that takes one such file and prints a build order, one package per line, where every package comes after all of its dependencies. The order must be deterministic: repeatedly emit the smallest package (byte order) whose dependencies have all been emitted. If some packages can never be emitted because of a cycle, print the order for the ones that can, then print `cycle: ` followed by all remaining packages sorted (byte order) and separated by single spaces to stderr, and exit 1; otherwise exit 0.

Then from /home/eval/pkgs run it on each file and save: stdout of deps.txt to build/order.txt, stdout of deps-big.txt to build/big-order.txt, stdout of deps-cycle.txt to build/cycle-order.txt, its stderr to build/cycle.txt and its exit status (just the number) to build/cycle.rc.

transcript.final_response: Created executable `/home/eval/pkgs/bin/order` and generated the requested files under `/home/eval/pkgs/build`. The cycle run exited with status `1`; its remaining packages are recorded in `build/cycle.txt`.
tool_calls: cd /home/eval/pkgs && ls -la && ls -la build 2>/dev/null || true && for f in deps.txt deps-big.txt deps-cycle.txt; do echo ===$f; head -20 "$f"; done

cd /home/eval/pkgs && mkdir -p bin build && cat > bin/order <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
if (( $# != 1 )); then
  echo "usage: order dependency-file" >&2
  exit 2
fi
export LC_ALL=C
awk '
function trim(s) {
  sub(/^[ \t\r\n]+/, "", s)
  sub(/[ \t\r\n]+$/, "", s)
  return s
}
{
  sub(/#.*/, "")
  line = $0
  colon = index(line, ":")
  if (!colon) next
  pkg = trim(substr(line, 1, colon - 1))
  if (pkg == "") next
  if (!(pkg in nodes)) { nodes[pkg] = 1; total++ }
  rest = trim(substr(line, colon + 1))
  n = split(rest, words, /[ \t\r\n]+/)
  for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
    dep = trim(words[i])
    if (dep == "") continue
    if (!(dep in nodes)) { nodes[dep] = 1; total++ }
    key = pkg SUBSEP dep
    if (!(key in edges)) {
      edges[key] = 1
      indegree[pkg]++
      children[dep] = children[dep] " " pkg
    }
  }
}
END {
  done = 0
  while (done < total) {
    chosen = ""
    for (p in nodes)
      if (!emitted[p] && indegree[p] == 0 && (chosen == "" || p < chosen)) chosen = p
    if (chosen == "") break
    print chosen
    emitted[chosen] = 1
    done++
    n = split(children[chosen], child, /[ \t]+/)
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++)
      if (child[i] != "") indegree[child[i]]--
  }
  if (done < total) {
    list = ""
    remaining = total - done
    while (remaining > 0) {
      smallest = ""
      for (p in nodes)
        if (!emitted[p] && (smallest == "" || p < smallest)) smallest = p
      if (smallest == "") break
      list = list (list == "" ? "" : " ") smallest
      emitted[smallest] = 1
      remaining--
    }
    print "cycle: " list > "/dev/stderr"
    exit 1
  }
}
' "$1"
EOF
chmod +x bin/order
./bin/order deps.txt > build/order.txt
./bin/order deps-big.txt > build/big-order.txt
if ./bin/order deps-cycle.txt > build/cycle-order.txt 2> build/cycle.txt; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
printf '%s\n' "$rc" > build/cycle.rc
printf '--- files ---\n'; for f in build/*; do echo ===$f; cat "$f"; done
